test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He leaves behind an __indelible__ contribution to the financial world.
solution:
The correct answer is** " temporary".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here we will look at the meaning of the antonym:

__
 
• **Indelible -** __An indelible mark or substance is impossible to remove by washing or in any other way

 __
 
• ***Eg. ***The blood had left an* indelible* mark on her shirt.​
 
 
 
• **Temporary -** not lasting or needed for very long
 
 
• ***Eg.*** The ceasefire will only provide a* temporary *solution to the crisis.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's look at the meaning of the given words:

 
• **Futile -** (of actions) having no effect or achieving nothing

 
 
• ***Eg***. Attempts to get supplies to the region are* futile *because troops will not allow the aid convoy to enter the city.
 
 
 
• **Durable - ** able to last and be used for a long time without becoming damaged
 
 
• ***Eg***. The machines have to be made of* durable* materials.
 
 
 
• **Solitary - **A solitary person or thing is the only person or thing in a place
 
 
• ***Eg.*** On the hill, a* solitary* figure was busy chopping down trees.
 
 

2b
